messages:
maria: FYI — planning a fractional router probe in the 16:00 PT change window. target route: /api/v2 -> new-router v2.3. pin config and rollout plan below. please ack if you need to be added to the watchlist.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout job created: job_id=rb-2026-03-21-01, window=16:00-16:40 PT. Initial traffic slice=5% for 10m, then 20% for 10m, final shift to 50% if healthy. See /deploys/rb-2026-03-21-01

sam: adding test checklist here:
- smoke /api/v2 health endpoints (200 with header x-router=v2.3)
- p95 latency < 200ms on synthetic test
- error-rate delta < +0.5% vs baseline

jin: rolling metrics alert thresholds? what triggers rollback automated?

olivia: auto-rollback if 2 consecutive evaluation windows have error-rate > 1.0% absolute OR p95 increases by +200ms. manual rollback allowed at any time.

maria: pinning note: will pin session-affinity cookie mapping for v2.3 during probe to avoid cross-router sticky issues. config snippet:
```
router:
  route: /api/v2
  rollout_policy:
    - step: probe
      percent: 5
      duration: 600s
    - step: expand
      percent: 20
      duration: 600s
    - step: ramp
      percent: 50
      duration: 1200s
  session_affinity: pinned
  pinned_version: v2.3
```

sam: @maria quick Q — are we doing region-by-region or global split?

maria: region-by-region. start in us-west1 only, then us-east1 if us-west1 is green. eu-west1 held for a separate change window.

jin: i'll wire up a short synthetic that hits warm KV cache too. also enabling detailed traces for the new-router only (low-sample rate) so we can see cold path regressions.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks: config lint OK, infra capacity OK, secret access OK. Initiating warmup for 3 instances of v2.3 in us-west1.

olivia: release notes link: https://internal.redwood/release-notes/234 — includes model/behavior changes and rollout caveats. Please confirm docs updated in console too.

maria: docs updated. console route dashboard panel added: new-router v2.3 probe -> shows p50/p95/p99 + error-rate + qps.

sam: I want a manual gate at the 20% step. can we set deploy-bot to pause and wait for a ":proceed"?

maria: yep — changing job to require operator confirm after expand step. updated job_id=rb-2026-03-21-01 (manual gate at 20%).

jin: quick rollback playbook for on-call:
1) run `deploy-bot rollback rb-2026-03-21-01 --to-version v2.2`
2) validate routing header removed on all v2.3 instances
3) scale down v2.3 pool to 0 over 3m
4) notify #incidents and channel ops@redwood

olivia: tagging product here — if we see behavioral regressions > low-severity, hold and escalate. 

sam: ack. i'll be on watch for the window.

maria: @jin @sam @olivia thanks. last note: if the 5% probe shows an unexplained latency spike but error-rate stable, we still hold and instrument further — no auto-advance. :eyes: 

deploy-bot: Rollout job rb-2026-03-21-01 is now WAITING_FOR_WINDOW until 2026-03-21T23:00:00Z (16:00 PT). Operators: maria, sam, jin, olivia.

maria: one more — putting a short muted announcement to #general 10m before start so CS doesn't get surprised.

olivia: done. message queued. :white_check_mark:

sam: I'll post a quick snippet for observers to run during probe:
```bash
for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -H "x-experiment: observe" https://api.redwood.io/api/v2/health | jq .; sleep 2; done
```

jin: I'll attach a dashboard panel with a small derivative chart: delta_p95(v2.3 - baseline) so we can see deviation in real time.

maria: perfect. if anything flares, call rollback and ping #incidents. otherwise we'll reconvene 30m after the window close for notes.

olivia: ack — will draft post-rollout notes template.

sam: thanks team. see you at 16:00 PT. :rocket:
